display_name: ONNX-ASR (HiTZ Conformer Transducer Large v2, eu)
description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs the HiTZ Conformer Transducer Large v2 checkpoint for Basque, distinct from the nvidia conformer transducer checkpoint for the same language.
notes: Model from the OpenVoiceOS 'stt-asr-onnx' HuggingFace collection.
